day5_ending_forget_forced_1.text: *It's already too late. Only the cold mark where the needle was remains.*

day5_ending_forget_forced_2.text: ...I'm sorry. This time too, I was too late.

day5_ending_forget_forced_3.text: *Nurse Riin closed her eyes. She said something, but the sound was distant, like underwater.*

day5_ending_forget_forced_4.text: *My consciousness drifted. Regret, anger — they all just slipped away, unspoken.*

day5_ending_ghost_guided_1.text: *Amidst the blackout, the emergency bell rang once. Someone roughly shoves my back.*

day5_ending_ghost_guided_2.text: ...Don't stop. Your body remembers the way.

day5_ending_ghost_guided_3.text: *I ran up the stairs two at a time. Seolhwa seems to be leading. My feet are already headed for the emergency exit.*

day5_ending_ghost_guided_4.text: Good. Keep going. Now, just push the door.

day5_ending_ghost_guided_5.text: *The door opened, and cold air rushed in. That's when I finally caught my breath.*

day5_ending_true_1.text: *Ms. Eunsu's hand trembles. The fingers gripping the syringe are white.*

day5_ending_true_5.text: *I passed through the emergency exit. With Yuna. The fire escape behind the old wing. The dawn air is cold. Beyond the school fence -- the road is visible.*

day5_ending_true_7.text: ***Seolhwa is standing inside the emergency exit. She can't step outside the door.***

day5_ending_true_12.text: I waited 6 cycles. For you to get out.

day5_ending_true_13.text: ...I ended a year ago. If you get out, that is enough.

day5_ending_true_14.text: I'll remember you. Lee Seolhwa. Left-handed Lee Seolhwa.

day5_ending_true_14a.text: ...So, in the end, I lost. To that child.

day5_ending_true_14b.text: *The teacher's hand went limp. The syringe fell to the floor and rolled away.*

day5_ending_true_15.text: *Seolhwa stopped. She looked back. Light glistened at the corners of her eyes, but the corners of her mouth were turned up.*

day5_ending_true_16.text: ...That's the first time anyone's called my name. After 13 cycles.

day5_ending_true_17.text: *Seolhwa's body turns translucent. Scattering into particles of light.*

day5_ending_true_18.text: *The smell of rainy stairs, a wet uniform sleeve, the cold hand that held my left -- all of it rushes in at once.*

day5_ending_true_19.text: *For an instant, scenes rush in with no order at all.*

day5_ending_true_20.text: ***The memories of the 7th cycle. The night Seolhwa and I searched for documents in the library. The promise made in front of the locked basement door. The moment we tried to climb the fence together--***

day5_ending_true_21.text: ***And the memories before that. The 1st, the 2nd, the 3rd-- twelve lives crash in all at once.***

day5_ending_true_21a.text: *Minsu's profile picture changes to the gray default image. The wall of my old classroom goes blank white, and my parents' reason for moving cuts off mid-sentence. Other scenes enter through those blanks.*

day5_ending_true_22.text: *My knees hit the floor. My breath broke twice. Yuna came over and wrapped her arms around my back. In the cold night air, only Yuna's hands were warm.*

day5_ending_true_24.text: *Yuna gazed at the brightening sky, at the world beyond the school fence, and whispered softly.*

day5_ending_true_26.text: *A news article. 'Unlicensed Research Facility Discovered at XX High School -- Allegations of Illegal Drug Administration and Human Clinical Trials'*

day5_ending_true_27.text: *'Multiple victims report memory disorders... Lead researcher B arrested' '3-year student C, who collected evidence while enrolled, played a decisive role in the expose'*

day5_ending_true_28.text: *I set down my phone. The window. A new school. A new classroom. A place where no one knows me.*

day5_ending_true_29.text: *I looked at the name tag. My name. ...Not the 13th name, but the first one.*

day5_ending_true_30.text: *I remember. Twelve names, Seolhwa's voice, and the faces of Eunsu, Riin, Sea, and Yuna.*

day5_ending_true_31.text: *I picked up the pencil with my left hand. A habit from the 7th cycle. Seolhwa's habit. -- My habit.*

day5_ending_true_subtitle.text: Graduation -- From the classroom that never graduated, at last.

day5_postcredit_2.text: *A spacious office. Stacks of documents on a desk. Multiple monitors. A school blueprint on the screen.*

day5_postcredit_3.text: Yes. ...Confirmed. The site will be decommissioned. Asset recovery is complete, and personnel will be reassigned.

day5_postcredit_4.text: The media is noisy about Subject 13. Per protocol, we'll frame it as an individual's misconduct at the site level. Sever all ties to the Edina Foundation.

day5_postcredit_5.text: ...Yes. The selection of the next pilot school is complete.

day5_postcredit_6.text: Has the staff reassignment proposal been submitted?

day5_postcredit_7.text: *The monitor screen changes. A photo of a new school. New uniforms. New names. The file title is visible. 'Edina Foundation -- Maladjusted Student Correction Program, Site 2 Implementation Plan.' The same logo at the top of the document. An open book and a brain inside a circle.*

day5_postcredit_8.text: *...A new transfer student's profile appears on screen. The student in the photo is smiling. With a face that knows nothing.*

day5_ending_escape_1.text: *I ran. With Yuna. Escaped the school.*

day5_ending_escape_2.text: *I looked back. No one is following.*

day5_ending_escape_3.text: *Even after I got outside the school gate, I could not stop running for a while.*

day5_ending_escape_4.text: ...Sunbae, the documents are gone. There are photos on the camera, but...

day5_ending_escape_6.text: *I walked. The predawn road. Under a streetlight.*

day5_ending_escape_7.text: *...My head is quiet. Only the spot where Seolhwa had been standing stays blank.*

day5_ending_escape_8.text: *When I look back toward the school, only one third-floor window in the old building is dark and empty.*

day5_ending_escape_11.text: *Yuna bites her lip. Swallows her words.*

day5_ending_escape_12.text: *...I was gripping the bag strap with my left hand. Unconsciously.*

day5_ending_escape_14.text: *I typed ○○ High School into the news search bar. No new articles appeared.*

day5_ending_escape_15.text: Sunbae. Today at that school... they say a new transfer student arrived.

day5_ending_resist_2.text: You're a victim too, Teacher. You were used by the board.

day5_ending_resist_4.text: No. From the 3rd time on, it was my choice.

day5_ending_resist_6.text: Even so. If you stay here, the 14th cycle begins. For someone else.

day5_ending_resist_7.text: *Ms. Eunsu stopped. Seolhwa appeared. Behind Ms. Eunsu.*

day5_ending_resist_9.text: *Ms. Eunsu turned around. She saw Seolhwa.*

day5_ending_resist_11.text: After that day, I watched six more times. You welcoming a new name tag.

day5_ending_resist_12.text: And that smile breaking a little more each time.

day5_ending_resist_14.text: *Ms. Eunsu set the syringe on the floor. ...She stood there for a long time.*

day5_ending_resist_15.text: ...If I go outside, everything I did will come to light.

day5_ending_resist_18a.text: The 11th Oh Taehyun... said he trusted me. That it was all right because I was his teacher.

day5_ending_resist_18b.text: *Teacher stopped speaking. Her hands trembled ever so slightly.*

day5_ending_resist_18c.text: ...That night I erased his memory. The next morning he said to me, 'Who are you, miss?'

day5_ending_resist_18d.text: That was when I knew what I'd made wasn't a relationship, but a response chart. And still, I didn't stop.

day5_ending_resist_19.text: *Ms. Eunsu covered her mouth. Her breath broke twice.*

day5_ending_resist_20.text: ...How can you take me with you. After what I did to you.

day5_ending_resist_21.text: ...You should face consequences. But it's better than repeating this.

day5_ending_resist_22.text: *I passed through the emergency exit. With Ms. Eunsu. Seolhwa smiled from inside the door. Light scattered.*

day5_ending_resist_23.text: *Ms. Eunsu got out. But the stamp at the top of the documents remains.*

day5_ending_resist_24.text: *In the empty faculty room, a new homeroom teacher nameplate is set down. And at the empty desk -- a new transfer student.*

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_1.text: *Even after evening passed, the classroom lights stayed on. Ms. Eunsu arranged the attendance book as if nothing had happened.*

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_3.text: *I nodded. The words that had risen all the way up my throat sank back down.*

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_4.text: Starting tomorrow, just go back to normal. Same seat as in the attendance book.

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_5.text: *The classroom door closed softly. Even knowing it wasn't locked, I didn't get up from my seat.*

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_6.text: *...The next afternoon. The same classroom, the same window seat. Ms. Eunsu's voice rings faintly, like a bell.*

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_7.text: *The same class every day. The same classroom every day. The same smile every day.*

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_8.text: ***Am I happy? ...Am I supposed to be happy?***

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_9.text: *I looked out the window. The road beyond the fence. A car passes.*

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_10.text: *...The door is open. I can leave anytime.*

day5_ending_cage_eunsu_11.text: ***I don't leave. It's not that I can't -- I don't.***

day5_ending_cage_sea_3.text: This time -- I don't have to let you go, right?

day5_ending_cage_sea_4.text: *I nodded. Sea buried her forehead in my shoulder. Her breath drained out in one long exhale.*

day5_ending_cage_sea_6.text: *...The student council room. Sea opened a lunchbox. She looks at me and smiles.*

day5_ending_cage_sea_7.text: *...The 13th. No -- for Sea, the first. The first time she didn't have to let me go -- the only cycle.*

day5_ending_cage_sea_8.text: ***Yuna's camera is not by the library window. Only the habit of touching the left wall every night remains.***

day5_ending_cage_sea_9.text: ***Inside the desk drawer, one name tag still remains empty.***

day5_ending_forget_4.text: ...If every blank name in that basement is going to come back to me...

day5_ending_forget_5.text: I can't. I don't have the confidence to carry all those names out with me.

day5_ending_forget_6.text: Please erase me. Make me forget everything.

day5_ending_forget_7.text: *Ms. Eunsu raised the syringe. Her hand is shaking.*

day5_ending_forget_9.text: *The needle entered my arm. Cold. Consciousness fades.*

day5_ending_forget_10.text: *The last thing I saw -- Seolhwa. Seolhwa is crying. Her lips move. No sound.*

day5_ending_forget_11.text: *...I can read it. The movement of her lips.*

day5_ending_forget_14.text: *...It's bright. An alarm is ringing. I looked at my phone.*

day5_ending_forget_16.text: *The name is different. I looked in the mirror. ...Who is this? It's me. It is me.*

day5_ending_forget_17.text: *Tears ran down to the tip of my chin. I couldn't think of any reason to wipe them away.*

day5_ending_forget_18.text: *I need to go to school. A new school.*

day5_ending_forget_19.text: *A teacher is standing at the school gate.*

day5_ending_forget_20.text: Welcome. You're {new_name}, right? The transfer student?

day5_ending_forget_21.text: I'll look after your school life from now on.

day5_ending_forget_22.text: *Teacher smiled. Warmly. The corners of her mouth and eyes rose in the same rhythm.*

day5_ending_forget_sea_1.text: *A girl is standing at the school gate. A bright smile. Class representative armband.*

day5_ending_forget_sea_2.text: Hi! You're the new transfer student, right? I'll show you around.

day5_ending_forget_sea_3.text: *...This person looks familiar. Where was it? ...I cannot remember.*

day5_ending_ghost_1.text: *My feet won't lift, as if they're stuck to the floor.*

day5_ending_ghost_3.text: *...Seolhwa appeared. Between me and Ms. Eunsu.*

day5_ending_ghost_6.text: I watched for 6 cycles. You not being able to decide.

day5_ending_ghost_7.text: This time too. I know. It's a habit.

day5_ending_ghost_9.text: *Seolhwa looked straight at me. Eyes that exist in no camera, no attendance book, are clearer than anyone's in this moment.*

day5_ending_ghost_11.text: *My body moved. My toes turned toward the emergency exit.*

day5_ending_ghost_12.text: *I grabbed Yuna's hand and ran for the emergency exit. Ms. Eunsu shouted from behind but I didn't stop.*

day5_ending_ghost_13.text: *I stepped out through the emergency exit. I looked back. Seolhwa is standing inside the door. She is smiling with light gathered at the corners of her eyes.*

day5_ending_ghost_15.text: *Seolhwa vanished. Soundlessly. At the same time, an alarm rang inside the building. Sirens, footsteps, and shouts tangled together.*

day5_ending_ghost_16.text: *Seolhwa's voice could no longer be heard. I escaped the school. Behind me, sirens wailed.*

day5_ending_ghost_17.text: *A new place. A new life. The blank remains. Only the habit in my left hand is left.*

day5_ending_ghost_18.text: *Sometimes at night, when I look in the mirror, silver-white hair passes by one beat late.*

day5_ending_ghost_19.text: *When I pick up a pencil with my left hand. When I turn left in a hallway. When I start to call someone's name and stop.*

day5_ending_ghost_20.text: *A stroke bending left, the nick in the second stair, the breath before calling a name.*

day5_ending_ghost_21.text: *My left hand finds the railing first. In hallways, I end up walking along the left wall.*

day5_ending_ghost_22.text: *That school is still there. A new lock hangs on the emergency exit, and the key is in another hand.*

day5_ending_ghost_subtitle.text: Afterimage -- Traces that cannot be erased.

day5_ending_complicit_1.text: *Ms. Eunsu held out a piece of paper.*

day5_ending_complicit_2.text: If you become the handler for the 14th -- your memory will never be erased again.

day5_ending_complicit_3.text: Stay here. I'll register you as an assistant. Let's manage it together.

day5_ending_complicit_5.text: *I looked at the paper. 'Project Nevergrad -- Assistant Researcher Contract.'*

day5_ending_complicit_6.text: ...When the 14th comes, do I tell that kid, 'I'll look after your school life from now on,' too?

day5_ending_complicit_8.text: *I placed my hand on the contract.*

day5_ending_complicit_8a.text: *...My hands aren't shaking. For some reason. They should be.*

day5_ending_complicit_8b.text: *Staying here is easier than running. My legs do not move toward the door.*

day5_ending_complicit_sign.text: *I gripped the pen. My hand obeys.*

day5_ending_complicit_12.text: *The school gate. Morning. A new student walks up. The 14th.*

day5_ending_complicit_13.text: *...Same face. Different hair color. Different name.*

day5_ending_complicit_15.text: *The 14th nods. Fingers grip and release the bag strap three times.*

day5_ending_complicit_16.text: Don't worry. There are lots of good people here.

day5_ending_complicit_17.text: ***Ms. Eunsu is watching from behind. At the end of the hallway, Seolhwa is standing. Light gathers at the corners of her eyes.***

day5_ending_complicit_subtitle.text: Accomplice -- The classroom that never graduates.

day5_xover_server_1.text: *Connected to the institute's server. A file directory appears on the old monitor.*

day5_xover_preview_2.text: *Spring breeze. New uniform. First day of transfer.*

day5_xover_preview_3.text: *Cherry petals repeat from the same position. Only the wind direction changes.*

day5_xover_preview_4.text: *Bottom right of the screen, in small text: cycle_01*
